summary: Investigate files/data (images, pcaps, memory dumps, disk images, archives) to recover hidden info. Workflow: identify the artifact type -> apply the matching extraction (carving / stego / pcap / memory / disk) -> recover the flag. Start with the cheapest checks (file, strings, exiftool, binwalk).
quick_triage: file artifact ; strings -n 6 artifact | grep -iE 'flag|ctf\{' ; xxd artifact | head  (magic bytes & obvious text).
Route by type: image -> stego path; pcap -> wireshark/tshark; mem dump -> volatility3; disk image -> sleuthkit/autopsy; archive -> extract (crack if encrypted); office/pdf -> embedded-object tools.
ALWAYS run binwalk + exiftool on any file: appended/embedded data and metadata are the #1 hiding spots.
For images also run zsteg (PNG/BMP) or steghide (JPG/WAV) and check with stegsolve bit-planes.
If a magic-byte/header looks corrupted, repair it (correct the signature) and reopen.
Audio -> look at the spectrogram. QR/barcode -> zbarimg.

tools.name: binwalk
tools.when: ALWAYS. Find + extract embedded/appended files and filesystems inside any blob.

tools.name: exiftool
tools.when: ALWAYS on media/docs. Read metadata (comments, GPS, author, hidden fields).

tools.name: strings + xxd
tools.when: First look for plaintext/encoded flags and to read magic bytes.
tools.usage: strings -n 6 -e l artifact | grep -i ctf ; xxd artifact | head

tools.name: foremost / scalpel / photorec
tools.when: File carving — recover files by signature from a blob/disk image when binwalk misses.

tools.name: zsteg
tools.when: LSB/stego in PNG and BMP (the go-to for PNG stego).

tools.name: steghide
tools.when: Hidden data in JPG/BMP/WAV/AU (often passphrase-protected).
tools.usage: steghide extract -sf image.jpg -p '' ; steghide info image.jpg

tools.name: stegseek
tools.when: Brute-force a steghide passphrase fast with a wordlist.

tools.name: stegsolve / stegolab
tools.when: Visually step image bit-planes / color channels (GUI) to spot hidden pixels.

install.note: stegsolve.jar (Java); or use python PIL to split planes headlessly

tools.usage: java -jar stegsolve.jar  (headless: PIL to extract LSB plane)

tools.name: outguess
tools.when: JPEG stego alternative to steghide.

tools.name: pngcheck
tools.when: Validate/repair PNG structure; find appended chunks or wrong dimensions hiding content.

tools.name: wireshark / tshark
tools.when: PCAP analysis: follow streams, extract files/credentials/flags from traffic.
tools.usage: tshark -r cap.pcap -q -z follow,tcp,ascii,0 ; tshark -r cap.pcap --export-objects http,out/

tools.name: volatility3
tools.when: Memory-dump forensics: processes, cmdlines, files, hashes, injected code.
tools.usage: vol -f mem.raw windows.pslist ; vol -f mem.raw windows.cmdline ; vol -f mem.raw windows.filescan

tools.name: The Sleuth Kit (fls/icat/mmls)
tools.when: Disk-image forensics: list files (incl. deleted), extract by inode, read partition table.
tools.usage: mmls disk.dd ; fls -r -o <offset> disk.dd ; icat -o <offset> disk.dd <inode> > file

tools.name: bulk_extractor
tools.when: Sweep a disk/mem image for emails, URLs, PII, and flag-looking strings fast.

tools.name: john (zip2john/pdf2john/rar2john)
tools.when: Crack encrypted archives/PDFs/office files.

tools.name: zbarimg
tools.when: Decode QR codes / barcodes in images.

tools.name: sox / Audacity / Sonic Visualiser
tools.when: Audio stego: spectrogram (text drawn in frequencies), DTMF, slowed/reversed.

tools.name: oletools / pdf-parser
tools.when: Office macros and PDF objects/streams (malicious or hidden content).

tools.name: NetworkMiner
tools.when: PCAP network-forensics GUI: auto-extract transferred files, images, credentials, sessions.

install.note: netresec.com (.NET; runs on Linux via mono)

tools.name: aircrack-ng
tools.when: Crack WEP/WPA-PSK from a captured 802.11 handshake in a pcap.

tools.name: ImageMagick
tools.when: Convert/inspect/transform images (format changes, channel/plane extraction, deblur steps).

tools.name: StegCracker
tools.when: Brute-force steghide-embedded data with a wordlist (needs steghide installed).
